verdicts.why: Settled by the owner: the stage stays on S1#7 so the assassin is not named too early (NOTES, nrv05 n197).
In A Sin to Err Dottie knocks Peggy out with the Sweet Dreams Lipstick kiss and Peggy sees her handcuff scars as she falls; they do not fight until later titles.
In Smoke & Mirrors Masters arrives with FBI agents, halts the Arena Club raid with an executive order and audit, and warns Peggy her allies may not survive; the second sentence sums up his later arc.
Current text is true for The Atomic Job: Sousa and Jarvis work together with Peggy on the warehouse heist against Frost. The fix is a reword, not a factual correction.

Nothing passes between Sousa and Frost in Life of the Party (he monitors from the van) and the text is about Sousa and Peggy. In The Edge of Mystery Sousa and Carter trade fake rods for Wilkes; a dropped case exposes them and Frost orders Manfredi to kill them as they flee.
In The Edge of Mystery Sousa threatens to say Manfredi gave up Tommy Fontana, so Manfredi agrees to carry the uranium-for-Wilkes offer to Frost; he then stands with Frost at the exchange.
S2#8: Thompson overhears Masters taking Frost's orders, confronts him, and Masters uses the Memory Inhibitor. Vega saying he was not to let Thompson live comes in A Little Song and Dance (S2#9).

Thompson is not stringing them along for Masters: he betrays Masters to Frost and secretly means to blow up Frost, Masters and Wilkes. The proposed 'along with Vernon Masters' can read as Masters being his partner, so it is reworded.

value.text: Jack Thompson goes to Whitney Frost to tell her the Gamma Cannon is not ready, and her partner Joseph Manfredi calls him stupid and threatens him. Thompson is secretly playing Frost and Vernon Masters against each other, planning to blow them both up.
value.on_b_card_about_a: An agent Manfredi threatens, who secretly plans to blow up Frost.

verdicts.why: In A Little Song and Dance Manfredi drags Wilkes out of the car and orders him to obey, then watches Frost try to extract the Zero Matter from him and urges a pause before his heart gives out. Wilkes is the subject, not a worker on the experiments.
Howard is in the car Jarvis drives into Frost (the wiki itself says 'driven by Edwin Jarvis and Howard Stark'), so the text and card lines are not false; the fix is a reword.

It is a late breakfast, not dinner. But Jarvis does not bring Manfredi in at gunpoint: Manfredi breaks in and holds Jarvis at gunpoint to reach Stark ('you can't just walk into a man's home and take his butler hostage').

value.text: Worried about Frost's obsession with the rift, Manfredi holds Jarvis at gunpoint to reach Stark, Peggy and Wilkes over a late breakfast, and agrees to help them by distracting Frost while they steal her plans.

verdicts.why: In T.A.H.I.T.I. Trip arrives with Garrett, stays on the Bus with Simmons in case his medical training is needed, helps her treat Skye's seizure and shows an attraction to her. Their close friendship comes in later titles.

In End of the Beginning Blake and Hand board the Bus for Coulson's briefing; after Deathlok caves in Blake's chest, Hand tells Coulson the plan was flawed from the start. Blake's double-agent suspicion is sourced to Turn, Turn, Turn (AoS117).

Yes Men only shows May telling an unnamed party 'Coulson knows'; the line is revealed as Fury's in Turn, Turn, Turn, where stage 1 already covers May's reports. Any S1#15 stage on Fury's card gives the reveal away (the same reasoning that kept Dottie/Krzeminski at its reveal title).
On screen Sif says Odin ordered it, and the show never states that Loki was posing as Odin here; that is a wiki inference from the timeline, so under the evidence rule it passes.

Every claim is true (Po was Centipede's line to the Clairvoyant, interrogated Coulson and was killed by the Clairvoyant), and the stage sits at the reveal title, never earlier than the events, the same way the owner kept Dottie/Krzeminski at its reveal. The proposal is a reword.

Skye regroups with the team as Garrett is exposed as the Clairvoyant in Turn, Turn, Turn, so learning he was behind Quinn's shooting is a fair reading. The proposal is also off: that Quinn shot her on the Clairvoyant's orders already came out in T.A.H.I.T.I.
Current text is true: Garrett recruited Quinn (AoS112) and Quinn rejoins him in Providence after S.H.I.E.L.D. falls. The fix is a reword.
In Providence Trip joins Coulson's team and escapes the Hub with them to the coordinates that lead to Providence; 'become close friends as they hunt Hydra' sums up later titles.
In Providence Trip joins the team and goes with May and the others to follow Coulson's coordinates; 'fights beside May on mission after mission' sums up later titles.
Owner's rule 37: names the screen never says are kept unless they give a later reveal away; 'Blackout' stays (NOTES).
In Providence Talbot contacts Coulson after S.H.I.E.L.D. is named a terrorist group and sends a military team to the Hub, so the hunt starts at S1#18.
In Ragtag, after the team meeting, May talks with Skye about Ward and offers to be her new S.O.; 'over the years they become close friends' sums up later seasons.

In Ragtag the dying Garrett orders Ward to kill Fitz and Simmons, and Ward ejects their pod into the ocean instead. The text fix is right, but both card lines still say Garrett has Jemma dumped in the ocean, which is the same error.

value.text: Garrett orders Grant Ward to kill Jemma and Fitz, and Ward ejects them into the ocean instead of shooting them.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Hydra's Clairvoyant, who wins the team's trust, then orders Jemma killed.
value.on_b_card_about_a: An agent of Coulson's whom Garrett orders Ward to kill.

verdicts.why: In Beginning of the End Fury rescues them, Simmons wakes on his jet, he tells her Fitz is alive and she tells him where to find Coulson. Fury asks Coulson, not her, to rebuild S.H.I.E.L.D.

In Shadows Creel kills Browning at the deal and escapes; later, at the warehouse, he attacks Hartley as she opens the Obelisk's case, she grabs it to defend herself, Hunter cuts off her arm, and Creel flips the SUV.

In Nothing Personal May tracks Hill down after a Senate hearing to ask about T.A.H.I.T.I. Hill approving May's desk transfer is only revealed in S2#17, and 'Hill's field office' has no source, so the backstory and the card lines that carry it are cut.

value.text: After S.H.I.E.L.D. falls, Melinda May tracks down Maria Hill outside a Senate hearing to find out who ran Project T.A.H.I.T.I., the program that brought Coulson back.
value.on_a_card_about_b: An agent who tracks Hill down to ask about T.A.H.I.T.I.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Fury's deputy, whom May tracks down to ask about T.A.H.I.T.I.

verdicts.why: In S1#22 Fitz is left in a dire state after nearly drowning and is not at Coulson's side. In Shadows Coulson explains that Fitz's brain damage has made him withdrawn and has had him working on cloaking for the Bus. A stage must say what happens between the two.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#1
value.text: Coulson keeps Fitz on his team despite the brain damage that leaves him withdrawn, and has him working on cloaking for the Bus.

verdicts.why: Their connection clearly starts in The Magical Place: Skye storms in, punches Raina out to rescue Coulson, and Raina is arrested. Stage 0 at S1#22 can stay, since it is not earlier than what it says.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1#11
value.text: Skye storms the Centipede facility and knocks Raina out with a punch to rescue Coulson, and Raina is arrested.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A Centipede operative Daisy knocks out to rescue Coulson.
value.on_b_card_about_a: A hacker who knocks Raina out to rescue Coulson.

verdicts.why: Both card lines tell later seasons' friendship on a one-stage S1#21 tie (N4). Trimming them is enough, and the mentor kind already carries the through-line. (Their tie also starts well before S1#21, which is a separate check.)
Mack's wish to see Creel dead for Hartley is stated only in S5#21 (AoS521), so it is cut. The new card line opens with Creel's codename, which names him first against house style, so it is reworded.

value.text: Mack helps Fitz rebuild the Overkill Device into the weapon that lets Coulson take down Carl Creel.
value.on_a_card_about_b: The man Coulson takes down with a weapon Mack helps build.

verdicts.why: In Heavy Is the Head Talbot asks Hunter to give up Coulson; it is Hunter who demands a proper burial for Hartley and two million dollars.

The current text is a third party's act, not something between them. In Making Friends and Influencing People Fitz, through Mack, tells Coulson that Gill has trouble making friends, then confronts Ward and has Mack radio that Gill was brainwashed by Hydra.

In Making Friends and Influencing People Bakshi accuses Simmons of lying and grills her about knowing Gill, takes her on the mission and feeds her lines, and Skye fakes a shot so she can pretend to save him. 'Never suspects' is false.
Their first on-screen exchange is the bet over Skye's Academy record in Making Friends and Influencing People (S2#3), which Hunter loses and pays off with inventory work, so the stage starts there.
In A Fractured House Mack tells Simmons he only knows this Fitz, who is better without her, and she tearfully agrees; 'become close friends' tells a later through-line.
